verdict.rationale: OpenCode ships an official, documented CLI (https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/). It installs via curl or npm, runs one-shot prompts with `opencode run`, creates agents interactively, and supports `--auto` approval. It also offers headless `opencode serve` and `attach` to remote backends. Community users corroborate daily terminal use and `opencode serve`, though one reports the TUI failing to open on Wayland and another reports unreliable file edits with local models. Missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable/structured output modes for scripting, and a fuller command reference beyond individual snippets.
